snippet.title: BIO DEFENSE - ATARI 800 XL !!! LONG PLAY  80´S NOSTALGIA
snippet.description:
One of the first games ever with voice synthesizer. Help the poor human, you are an antibody and have the mission to destroy all virus which have put you in a coma due to high infection.

Advice : 
1.-Beware of sphere-shaped virus, antibody can´t eat it if you want to throw it      antibody will die instantly.
2.- It is better to finish with little virus at first cos they are duplicated in a bigger one.

Thanks to Gem Games Inc. for this Gem Game.

Download :
http://gury.atari8.info/detail.php?id=675&src=2
